name: Introduction to Research in Project Studies

assessments.name: Workshop Engagement and Participation
assessments.description:
Participation may include:
•	Contribution to workshop discussions
•	Preparation for class activities
•	Engagement and participation
•	Constructive and respectful collaboration

assessments.name: Early Feedback Task
assessments.description: Students complete a short online quiz to confirm early engagement with the unit, including engagement with unit materials and initial research topic development.

assessments.name: Initial Research Proposal Draft
assessments.description: Students submit an initial research proposal draft that outlines their developing research topic, research problem, research question, relevant literature, and possible methodology.

assessments.name: Weekly Learning Journal
assessments.description: Students maintain weekly reflective journals from Week 1 to Week 10, reflecting on pre-class preparation, workshop experiences, and their developing understanding of research and proposal development.

assessments.name: Provisional Individual Research Presentation
assessments.description: Students individually present their final research proposal and respond to questions and feedback from peers and teaching staff.
assessments.length: Presentation and Q&A -20 mins per person

assessments.name: Final Individual Written Research Proposal
assessments.description: Students submit a complete individual research proposal demonstrating a clear research problem, focused research question, relevant literature, appropriate methodology, ethical awareness, and a coherent research plan.
